status: all provenance, frozen-policy and query-validation checks passed

identity.verification_scope: Local logs/archives are hashed. Binary, immutable native generation and C++ artifact identities are separately collected host declarations, bound consistently before and after timing.

distance_cutoff_diagnostic.metric: distinct returned IDs with exact integer squared L2 <= exact Kth truth distance, divided by K

original_tuning_weights_restricted_to_te.scope: Original tuning label weights, renormalized to the 34 covered labels; no throughput inference

uncertainty.resampling_unit: paired query hit-count difference; neighbors and timing repeats are not independent quality samples
uncertainty.simultaneous_method: Bonferroni-adjusted percentile bootstrap, family of tested labels only
uncertainty.interval_coverage: Nominal approximate bootstrap coverage, not a distribution-free bound
uncertainty.limitations: Intervals describe empirical query resampling, not a guarantee for future ads traffic. A constant observed difference gives a degenerate interval; rare/unseen queries may behave differently. No noninferiority margin was selected after seeing the holdout.

interpretation: Recall shortfalls are reported, never rejected or used to alter the frozen plan.
The holdout contains every eligible remaining public one-tag query. Labels exhausted by tuning are untested, rather than passing.
Query-weighted throughput reflects this natural holdout mixture; it differs from the label-balanced tuning mixture.
Per-label mean/p99 describe service calls inside a concurrent mixed workload. No per-label QPS is inferred.
Performance summaries are medians of complete warmed repetitions, with raw repeat ranges; per-label tails with few samples are explicitly flagged.
Graphs, entry points and breadths differ; this compares complete frozen configurations, not isolated language speed.
Closed-loop eight-worker QPS and latency do not establish a production arrival-rate SLO.
